attchmntText: Lovable Lingerie Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lovable Lingerie Limited announced the Board approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Statutory auditors DMKH & Co. issued a limited review report. The company reported a profit after tax of 158.06 Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, profit after tax was 506.89 Crore. Earnings per share were 1.07 for the quarter and 3.42 for the six-month period. Total income from operations was 3,341.97 Crore for the quarter. Total assets stood at 23,952.01 Crore as of September 30, 2026, compared to 19,817.68 Crore as of March 31, 2026. Paid-up share capital remained at 1,480.00 Crore. The results are available on the company and exchange websites.
